caption:
Five Friday drops left. The first one is tonight.

The Supply Drop runs live on stream every Friday at 6 PM PT through New Year's Day. Register on the Supply Drop page (link in bio), then catch uplinks on stream and claim them in #uplink-terminal in the Black Point Discord.

Drop nights: Dec 4, 11 and 18. Christmas Day: the $300 Visa cash card at 6 PM PT and 3rd place at 11 PM PT. Midnight on New Year's Eve: 2nd place. New Year's Day, Fri Jan 1 at 6 PM PT: the grand prize, a gaming PC tower or gaming laptop, winner's choice.

US only · 18+ · Discord required. Full rules on the website. Black Point Gaming never DMs winners asking for payment or fees.
